meta.source: Tesla homepage — live visual audit and supplied Testla.xml snapshot

colorSystem.observation: Neutral interface layers sit over high-impact photography.

typography.hierarchy: Medium-weight headings, short subheads and direct CTAs.
typography.doNotCopy: Universal Sans is not used in the portfolio.

layout.pattern: Immersive full-width sections with content anchored to stable grid positions.

spacing.principle: Large hero zones; actions stay grouped and easy to scan.

navigation.mobile: Compact brand and one explicit menu trigger.

hero.pattern: Immediate focal statement and one dominant action.

buttons.pattern: Wide, calm targets with direct language and little ornament.

cards.pattern: Fewer, larger modules rather than dense card mosaics.

imageTreatment.pattern: Edge-to-edge visuals with careful focal cropping.

borders.pattern: Minimal; hierarchy relies on contrast and placement.

shadows.pattern: Shallow shadows only for floating controls.

motion.observedTransition: State changes around 330ms with firm easing.
motion.principle: Short and purposeful transitions; avoid ornamental motion.

scrollBehavior.pattern: Large narrative stages establish a steady viewing cadence.

responsiveBehavior.pattern: Mobile compresses copy and controls while preserving a strong focal point.

interactionStates.pattern: Clear hover and pressed feedback without dramatic scaling.

accessibilityPatterns.pattern: Large touch targets and direct action labels.

takeaways: Make the primary message obvious within one glance.
Use wide targets and direct CTA language.
